findings.description: Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc had a daughter, Antonia, born 15 August 1877 and baptised 29 October 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz, Guatemala; the baptism entry names her parents as Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc and her godparents as Manuel Tiul and María Santos.
